newsitem.title: UK: CSR quotes for Black Sea in sugar freight orders.
newsitem.headline: CSR quotes for Black Sea in sugar freight orders.

text.p: Reported business was calmer on London's sugar freight market on Tuesday after the spate of activity seen at the start of the week, shipbrokers said.

The most significant new order came from CSR, which joined the queue of suppliers exporting sugar into the Black Sea. CSR was open for 30,000 tonnes from Queensland to the Black Sea for July 10/20, they said.
Cargill again featured in the day's new enquiries and issued two new bulk orders for early July.
It quoted for 30,000 tonnes from its private berth in Santos to Iran and a further 29,000 tonnes from Durban to Egypt/Morocco/Black Sea/Baltic.
E D & F Man was said to have fixed its recent order for 13,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from south China to Pakistan but details of the rate have yet to emerge.
The Baltic Exchange reported a fixture for an unknown charterer at $33.00 for 12,600 tonnes of bulk sugar from Maceio to the Black Sea and $32.00 for a Baltic option.
It said the recently reported fixture for a cargo of 14,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from Santos to Lagos was not for the account of Sugar Export but did not name the correct party.
